title: Chapter 15 Distiller
content:
Chapter 15 Distiller

He hurried to the door, took out a large vat and placed it in the rain.

After a while, there was 1 unit of acid rain (1L). He started to use the "mud-smoothing" skill, but there was no response.

Wang Shuo was a little disappointed. He poured the acid rain into a pottery jar and put it on the fire. Soon, the system prompt sounded:

[You studied on your own and learned the distillation technology. Reward: distiller production drawing x 1. ]

"Is this okay?"

Wang Shuo was confused.

In fact, survival games encourage players to explore by themselves. From Wang Shuo's understanding of pottery, it can be seen that most players, facing the natural disasters that they cannot resist, chose to give up.

[Do you want to learn the "distiller production drawing"? ]

"Yes."

[Currently, you can make a "pottery distiller": 10 clay + 10 coal (50 charcoal)]

Wang Shuo opened his backpack and found that there was no clay left.

So he used "mud-smoothing" on the mud outside the house.

However, the system reminded him that the clay he got was corroded by acid rain and could not be used.

"Fuck."

There is such a cool operation. Wang Shuo was shocked by this system again.

It's all mud and water, and they have to be divided into levels. Wang Shuo was a little angry and laughed.

The world is big, and the system is the biggest.

I admit it!

Wang Shuo started to use his brain again to see if he could think of other ways.

After searching in the warehouse, he finally found some mud, which was what he collected at the beginning. He found a big vat, added mud and water, and then made clay.

He barely collected 10 pieces of clay.

Then he started to burn charcoal.

[Charcoal + 100]

1 wood got 100 charcoal, which is very cost-effective.

After the materials were prepared, Wang Shuo silently said in his heart, "Make a ceramic distiller."

[Ceramic distiller: clay 10/10, charcoal 100/50)]

[Are you sure to make it? 】

"Yes."

[Clay - 10, Charcoal - 50]

[Production time 1 hour]

It was time to wait again, so he took out all the empty vats and pottery jars, placed them under the eaves, and began to collect acid rain.

Acid rain is very corrosive to wood, but it is much less corrosive to pottery.

However, Wang Shuo still found that these pottery would become thinner every time they were used, and they might not be usable after a few uses.

An hour later, the system prompt sounded:

[Ceramic distiller + 1]

The acid rain was almost collected, so he moved everything to the workshop and started making sulfuric acid.

When the acid rain was poured into the distiller, the "synthesis formula" of sulfuric acid was obtained, and it was prompted that wood was needed.

[1 sulfuric acid + 99 water = 100 acid rain + 2 wood]

"It's quite advanced, like a chemical formula." Wang Shuo said with some admiration.

[Do you want to start making sulfuric acid? 】

"Yes."

[Acid Rain -100, Wood -2]

Without Wang Shuo's help, the distiller next to the tool bench began to burn fiercely, and the distillation pipe on the tool bench began to separate water and sulfuric acid.

When there was a small cup, Wang Shuo found that he had no container to hold sulfuric acid, so he could only put it directly into his backpack.

Watching the process of automation, Wang Shuo fell into silence. What kind of game is this and what is the purpose?

After thinking for a while, he had no answer and had to give up.

Then he lay down on the kang, and soon, he fell asleep.

When he woke up, it was already evening.

When he came to the workshop, the sulfuric acid solution had been extracted and put into the backpack, and 10 units of sulfuric acid were obtained. Although the water was clean, Wang Shuo felt a little uncomfortable and poured it all out.

Next, Wang Shuo made himself a hearty dinner again, and then went to sleep on the kang.

...

On the morning of the fourth day, Wang Shuo was awakened by a huge system prompt sound.

[Congratulations to all "bugs" for successfully surviving three days. You are now qualified to know my existence. 】

【You can call me Lord Zach. Seeing that you all slept soundly last night, I am very dissatisfied. 】

【I am now officially reminding you: your good days are over. 】

【This is a survival competition game, and there will be a constant stream of natural disasters and beasts. All you have to do is to keep surviving. On the morning of the 14th day, I will start the elimination round. I wish you good luck! 】

At this time, the [Chat Channel] exploded, and Lord Zach's words were pinned to the top of the [Chat Channel].

The comments of the players below were scrolling rapidly.

"Fuck, I said, someone must have dragged us into this game world, it's so scary!"

"It's over, it's over, I feel like I can't survive anymore!"

"Haha... With my current resources, I will definitely survive to the end."

"My fellow countrymen from the same planet, if you feel desperate, why not leave all your resources to me, I will live with your sustenance."

"The upstairs, I have never seen such a shameless person."

"The upstairs, the upstairs, you are probably dreaming."

"+1"

...

"I feel like I won't live to the knockout stage, I haven't had a good love yet, does anyone want to fall in love?"

"I don't want to, I just want to do..."

"Damn acid rain, trapped me here, damn Zach..."

The speech of the player who was cursing Lord Zach soon turned gray and was erased, obviously wiped out.

The other players were scared and dared not act recklessly again.

At this time, Wang Shuo was also frightened to the point that his heart was pounding, his mouth was dry, and he was panicked.

After a while, he calmed down.

"I have to develop quickly and improve my survival ability, otherwise I will die!"

He got up from the bed and went to the kitchen to make some food. He was not in the mood to make anything delicious now, so he just made some food to solve the hunger problem.

It was still raining outside and he couldn't go out. He didn't know what to do for a while.

Open the "Survivor's Handbook".

He found that the "Trading" column unlocked the "Trading Bank" function.

Players can put their items on the trading bank for consignment, or they can bid for a limited time. There is also a system store, which currently has no goods and can only sell supplies to the system, which is a system recycling function.

He quickly shouted in the [Chat Channel].

"There are new changes in the [Trading] column, you guys should check it out quickly."

"Hey, it's true!"

Soon, various consignment items appeared in the trading house.

Wang Shuo also put up some items that he didn't need much.

After having a wooden bow, the bamboo bow was useless, so he put up the bamboo bow and bamboo arrows.

[Bamboo bow for 10 wood]

[1 water for 10 stone, quantity in private chat]

...

Wang Shuo noticed that even the items posted in the trading house still existed in his backpack or warehouse, but these items were locked and could not be used.

He searched again and found an important resource - bronze ore.

This is the material for making bronze keys. After having a forging table and a furnace, Wang Shuo can smelt bronze ore and iron ore to make ingots.

And it also unlocked many "synthesis formulas", including bronze keys.

Wang Shuo quickly checked the transaction information.

This player wanted to use 100 bronze ores to exchange for 400 tiles.

Unfortunately, Wang Shuo has no tiles and clay left, so he can't make it. He silently memorized it and will trade it again when he has tiles.

He tried the system store function again, put one unit of wood in, and got 10 copper coins.

He was a little surprised that there was currency.

He tried again and put loach and eel in.

[Copper coins +3, copper coins +12...]

Different food sizes will get different currencies.

He got a total of 187 copper coins. The system prompted him that 100 copper coins can be exchanged for 1 silver coin. After the exchange, he found that there were 1 silver and 87 copper coins in his backpack.

It seems that there should be gold coins. After getting this information, he didn't try again.

The loach he put in just now was the first batch he caught. When he took it out, it was a bit smelly.

After understanding the new functions unlocked by the system, Wang Shuo no longer paid attention to it, but looked at the [Task] column.

At this time, a [side quest] was added:

Collect more supplies, build more buildings, make more tools, upgrade higher-level shelters... to get a higher ranking.

"I just don't want players to 'lie down'!"

"This is more terrible than 996, it just keeps players rolling inward."
